description.narrative:
Detta är ett avtal mellan Sida och FN:s hjälporganisation för Palestinska flyktingar i Mellanöstern (UNRWA), för att möjliggöra humanitära insatser vid de utvalda kriserna: - År 2023: Palestina, Syrien och Libanon - År 2024: Palestina och Libanon - År 2025: TBC
Bidraget från Sida består av finansiering till UNRWA:s två Emergency Appeals (EAs); det ockuperade palestinska territoriet (oPt) EA och Syrien, Libanon och Jordanien, tidigare känd som Syria Regional Crisis (SRC) och UNRWA:s Flash Appeal: 90 dagars initial nödrespons på upptrappningen i Gazaremsan.

This is an agreement between Sida and United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA), to allow for humanitarian response in the selected crises: - In 2023: Palestine, Syria and Lebanon - In 2024: Palestine and Lebanon - In 2025: TBC
The Contribution from Sida consists of funding to UNRWA’s two Emergency Appeals (EAs); the Occupied Palestinian Territory (oPt) EA, and the Syria, Lebanon and Jordan EA, previously known as Syria Regional crisis (SRC) and UNRWA's Flash appeal: 90 day initial emergency response to the escalation in the Gaza strip.

title.narrative: Amendment no 1 to the agreement between Sida and UNRWA
Grant agreement between Sida and UNRWA 2023-2025

description.narrative:
In 2025, no new results have been achieved as part of Sida's support to UNRWA. Sida last provided funding to UNRWA in 2024. Sida's decision to not provide funding to UNRWA in 2025 has been made in alignment with the decision by the Swedish Government in December 2024 to suspend Sweden's funding of UNRWA through the Ministry for Foreign Affairs.
Sida notes that despite operational challenges, UNRWA has managed to continue its work in both Gaza and the West Bank to a high extent during 2025. UNRWA's reports on 2025's operations are available through https://www.unrwa.org/resources/reports.
For example, in 2025, UNRWA distributed 880,000 cubic metres of drinking and domestic use water from different sources, while 70,000 tons of solid waste were collected and safely disposed of. UNRWA estimates that around 1.4 million people benefited from UNRWA water provision and solid waste collection services during the year.
Furthermore, during the January-March ceasefire in Gaza, UNRWA reached over 2 million people with critical food assistance. However, the agency has been blocked by Israeli authorities from directly bringing in any humanitarian assistance to Gaza since 2 March 2025, including food. Finally, as of January 2026, 65,000 children get access to education in UNRWA run Temporary Learning Spaces in Gaza, and almost 300,000 children access basic literacy and numeracy lessons on digital platforms.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
